prompt: The video begins with the camera moving steadily forward along a sandy path bordered by dense shrubbery, capturing the serene ambiance of Castle Rock Beach in Meelup, Australia. As the camera pans right, it reveals a breathtaking sunset scene where the sun dips into the horizon, casting a warm orange glow across the cloudy sky. The camera then focuses on the expansive beach, dotted with large rocks and framed by gentle waves lapping at the shore. Birds can be seen flying overhead, adding a dynamic element to the tranquil setting. The camera continues its smooth movement, shifting back to the left to showcase more of the lush vegetation and sand dunes that line the beach. The lighting gradually softens as the sun sets further, creating a gradient of colors from deep orange to muted purple. The camera angle remains low, emphasizing the texture of the sand and the intricate details of the surrounding flora. As the scene transitions, the camera moves deeper into the forested area, revealing a darker, more shadowed environment with tall trees and underbrush. The overall atmosphere remains peaceful and untouched, with no signs of human presence, highlighting the natural beauty and solitude of the location.
